title: On Defeating the neighbouring team by two goals
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：defeat　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 defeat 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the foreman ① defeated the neighbouring team by two goals twice over, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② defeats the neighbouring team by two goals year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ defeat the neighbouring team by two goals at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ defeated the neighbouring team by two goals before — a line in the sheet for May 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Defeating the neighbouring team by two goals twice over, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ defeat the plan by asking one question year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Defeat the plan by asking one question at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ defeats the plan by asking one question twice over every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ defeated the neighbouring team by two goals again when nobody else would.

⑩ To defeat the neighbouring team by two goals, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody defeats the neighbouring team by two goals year after year again and somebody must defeat the neighbouring team by two goals twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 击败（一般过去式 defeated the neighbouring team by two goals：1989 年工头头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 击败（一般现在 defeats the neighbouring team by two goals：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 击败（不定式 to defeat the neighbouring team by two goals：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 击败（过去完成时 had defeated the neighbouring team by two goals：1983 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 击败（动名词 defeating the neighbouring team by two goals 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 挫败（defeat the plan by asking one question：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去挫败一个问题把计划挫了）
G. v. 挫败（defeat the plan by asking one question：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 击败（后段两处：新来的工人照例 defeats the plan by asking one question，而母亲又一次 defeated the neighbouring team by two goals）

answers.why: defeat 意为“击败”，1989 年工头来回两遍击败以两球赢了邻队，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 defeated。
defeat 意为“击败”，自那以后工头年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 defeats。
defeat 意为“击败”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯击败以两球赢了邻队”，此处为不定式 to defeat the neighbouring team by two goals。
defeat 意为“击败”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人击败过，故用过去完成时 had defeated。
defeat 意为“击败”，工头说“击败以两球赢了邻队这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 defeating the neighbouring team by two goals 作主语。
defeat 意为“挫败”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去挫败一个问题把计划挫了”，should ever 之后用原形 defeat the plan by asking one question。
defeat 意为“挫败”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻挫败一个问题把计划挫了（defeat the plan by asking one question at once），以后再也不要提起。
defeat 意为“击败”，新来的工人每个班次都照例挫败一个问题把计划挫了，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 defeats。
defeat 意为“击败”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍击败以两球赢了邻队，用一般过去式 defeated 叙述。
defeat 意为“击败”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要击败以两球赢了邻队，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 defeat 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the foreman defeated the neighbouring team by two goals twice over, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman defeats the neighbouring team by two goals year after year whenever the site asks.
Defeating the neighbouring team by two goals twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever defeat the plan by asking one question year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site defeats the plan by asking one question twice over every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother defeated the neighbouring team by two goals again, and the site remembered that half.
